title: NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina E6177S/L: Step 2 of 4: Adapter Ligation
author: Opentrons
materials: PCR Enrichment](http://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/4b4a80-pcr_enrichment) With this protocol, your robot can perform the NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina E6177S/L protocol described by the [NEBNext E6177S/L](https://www.neb.com/products/e6177-nebnext-ultra-ii-fs-dna-library-prep-with-sample-purification-beads#Product%20Information). [NEB Instruction Manual for NEBNext E6177S/L](https://s3.amazonaws.com./pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2021-02-16/8q531ae/manualE6177-E7805.pdf). This is part 2 of the protocol: Adapter Ligation. This step performs the ligation with the NEBNext Adaptor followed by U excision. This protocol assumes up to 24 input DNA samples of > 100 ng and follows Section 2 of the NEB Instruction Manual. After the ligation and user enzyme steps carried out in this protocol (part 2), samples may be held overnight at -20 C before proceeding with part

steps.title: Prepare ligation mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the ligation mastermix, ligation enhancer, and ligation adapter; dispense the mixture into each fragmented DNA sample and mix thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Combine ligation mastermix, ligation enhancer, and ligation adapter.
Dispense the combined mixture to the fragmented DNA samples.
Mix each sample to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Run adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a thermocycler and run the adapter ligation program as specified in the NEBNext Ultra II FS kit protocol.

steps.title: Add user enzyme
steps.instruction: Add the User enzyme to each post‑ligation sample and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Run user enzyme treatment
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a thermocycler and run the User enzyme treatment program as specified in the NEBNext Ultra II FS kit protocol.
